keyVerseDR: "Bear ye one another's burdens; and so you shall fulfil the law of Christ." (Gal 6:2)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Citizenship
level1.story: Citizenship means working together and doing your part for your family, class, parish, and town.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice citizenship all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: How did each of us do our part this week?
How can our family help our parish or town?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Lord, help me be a good member of my family, parish, and town. Help me do my part. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Do your chores without being asked
TUE: Clean up a mess you didn't make
WED: Follow the rules at school
THU: Help your team in a game
FRI: Pick up litter at the park
SAT: Help get ready for Mass on Sunday

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Citizenship
level2.story: Citizenship means cooperating with others, being loyal to the groups we belong to, and doing our part. We are members of a family, a class, a parish, a town, and a country. Each one needs us! Saint Paul says to carry one another's burdens. Good citizens help the team, follow fair rules, care for shared places, and serve the common good.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice citizenship all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: How did each of us do our part this week?
How did God help us grow in citizenship?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Lord, help me be a good member of my family, parish, and town. Help me do my part. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Join a parish service project
TUE: Help a classmate on a group project
WED: Care for something shared, like a park
THU: Pray for leaders of our country
FRI: Recycle and take care of creation
SAT: Thank a firefighter, nurse, or helper
